anemone-auto-fertilizer.x: Anemone auto fertilizer is a type of [[farming|Farming]] equipment that enables a lumina sprinkler to also apply fertilizer to its affected tiles.
Before it can be crafted, it has to be developed from the [[oracle-chamber|underwater crafting lab]]. and its crafting recipe will be obtained afterward.
Once development is done, anemone auto fertilizer can be [[crafting|crafted]] by the player.

Anemone auto fertilizer can be attached to any lumina sprinkler that does not already have an attachment to allow it to fertilize seeds in any tilled soil with fresh seeds (crops that have not grown yet) in its area. It will prioritize left to right, top to bottom soil. Fertilizer must be placed in the lumina sprinkler in order to be used. It has 3 storage slots for fertilizer and will prioritize the leftmost fertilizer.
Anemone auto fertilizer cannot be gifted.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

bee-house.x: Bee house is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] that produces honey from [[flower|flowers]].

Bee house can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 3 in their [[catching|Catching]] mastery or by reading the Book 'Farming: Artisan goods guide' from the Library unlocked at Town Rank D.

After a bee house is placed on the player's farm, it can be loaded with a flower to produce honey. The player can place both grown and scavenged flowers into a bee house. Most flowers produce regular honey, except [[titan-arum|titan arum]] and [[rafflesia|rafflesia]] that produce black honey.
All honey takes 2 [[game-time|in-game days]] to produce. There is a 10% lower process time if Hasten Nature is learned.

mason-jar.x: Mason jar is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] that produces a variety of artisan products, including [[jam|jam]]s, [[pickle|pickle]]s, [[tempeh|tempeh]], salted [[egg-group|egg]]s and [[butter-group|butter]].
Mason jar can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 3 in their [[farming|Farming]] mastery.

After a crafted mason jar is placed on the player's farm, it can be loaded with an item to process it. Mason jar can process all [[egg|egg]] & [[milk|milk]] and most [[fruit-group|fruit]] & [[vegetable-group|vegetables]].
All pickles and salted eggs can be further processed in an [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].

keg.x: Keg is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] that can be used to juice [[fruit-group|fruit]]s and [[vegetable-group|vegetables]] and make [[green-tea|green tea]], [[coffee|coffee]], and some alcohols.
Keg can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 6 in their [[farming|Farming]] mastery.

After a crafted keg is placed on the player's farm, it can be loaded with an item to process it. A keg can process most harvestable grains, fruits & vegetables. Keg can't process any [[foraging|scavengeables]] besides [[coconut-group|coconuts]].
The following items cannot be placed into a keg: [[almond|Almond]], [[amaranth|Amaranth]], [[cocoa-bean|Cocoa bean]], [[olive|Olive]], [[soybean|Soybean]]
All of the products except for vegetable juices and cane nectar can be further processed in [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].

tap.x: Tap is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] that can be used to collect sap from wild [[trees|trees]].
Tap can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 4 in their [[foraging|Foraging]] mastery.

Once crafted, a tap can be placed on a fully grown tree to start collecting its sap. Its product can be collected after three days and will depend on the type of tree the player has tapped. Placed tap can be recovered by using [[axe|axe]].
All products produced by tapping can only be base (non-star) quality.
Note: due to a bug, the tap timer resets every time the player exits the game. In order to collect any product, the player needs to play at least three days in a single game session.

aging-barrel.x: An aging barrel is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] that can be used to ferment all [[cheese-group|cheese]]s, all salted [[egg-group|egg]]s, all [[fruit-juice-group|fruit juice]], all [[pickle|pickle]]s, all non-black [[honey|honey]], all [[coffee|coffee]], all [[beer|beer]] and [[sake|sake]] into preserved or alcoholic forms.
An aging barrel can also be used to refine [[artisan-product|artisan products]] that have already been aged, increasing their quality to the next star level.
Aging barrel can be crafted at Farming Level 10

After an aging barrel is placed on the player's farm, it can be loaded with cheeses, juices, pickles or other items to process them. Aging barrels will produce items twice as fast when put inside a shed or a cellar. Processing Times listed in the table below assume the barrel is indoors.

cheese-press.x: Cheese press is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] that produces [[cheese-group|cheese]] and goat cheese, as well as syrup and tofu.
The cheese press can be crafted after the player reached level 4 in their [[ranching|Ranching]] mastery.
The cheese press produces cheese from [[cow|cow]] and [[goat|goat]]'s milk. The product depends on the size and quality of the milk used.

mayonnaise-machine.x: Mayonnaise machine is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] in the game. It can produce mayonnaise from eggs laid by different [[coop|coop]] animals.
The player can receive 1 mayonnaise machine from [[jeff-smith|Jeff Smith]] in mail upon completing [[quest|The Farming Challenge pt. 3]]

Mayonnaise machine can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 2 in their [[ranching|Ranching]] mastery or by reading the Book 'Farming: Artisan goods guide' from the Library unlocked at Town Rank D.
Once crafted, a mayonnaise machine can be placed anywhere on the farm to produce mayonnaise. One egg turns into one jar of mayonnaise (or large mayonnaise depending on its size).

kiln.x: Kiln is a type of [[crafting|resource equipment]] that processes [[wood|wood]] into [[coal|coal]], and [[scrap|scrap]] and [[stone|stone]] into [[glass|glass]].
Kilns can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 2 in their [[foraging|Foraging]] mastery.
Once crafted, a kiln can be placed anywhere on the farm to produce coal and glass.

recycling-machine.x: Recyling machine is a type of [[crafting|resource equipment]] that turns [[trash|trash]] into [[scrap|scrap]].
Recyling machine can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 2 in their [[diving|Diving]] mastery.
Once crafted, a recycling machine can be placed anywhere on the farm and loaded with [[trash|trash]] to produce [[scrap|scrap]]. The player can queue up to 20 units of scrap to produce at a time.

dehydrator.x: The dehydrator is a type of [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] in the game. It produces [[hay|hay]], dried [[foraging|ocean scavengeables]], seaweed-based chips and dried scavengeable mushrooms. Unlike other artisan equipment, it can process up to 10 different items at one time.
A dehydrator can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 4 in their [[diving|Diving]] mastery.
After a dehydrator is placed on the player's farm, it can be loaded with ocean scavengeables to produce dried seafood, and chips, or with fiber to produce hay.

compost-bin.x: Compost bin is a type of [[crafting|resource equipment]] that turns [[trash|trash]] into compost.
Compost bin can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player reaches level 2 in their [[farming|Farming]] mastery.

Once crafted, a Compost bin can be placed anywhere on the farm and loaded with [[trash|trash]] to produce [[compost|compost]], an important component of [[fertilizer|fertilizer]]. Compost bin does not produce anything else. However, organic items such as scavengeables, insects and crops can also be loaded in there for 5 [[compost|compost]] each.

extractor.x: Extractor is a type of [[crafting|resource equipment]] that extracts kelp essence from [[kelp|kelp]]. The essence can then be used to upgrade [[crop|crop]] quality at the [[laboratory|Laboratory]].

Extractor can be [[crafting|crafted]] after the player obtains a [[bronze-kelp|bronze kelp]] in the ocean for the first time. An event will trigger the next morning when the player wakes up and exits their [[farmhouse|farmhouse]] when [[surya|Surya]] visits and gives them the crafting recipe.

Once crafted, an extractor can be placed anywhere on the farm and loaded with kelp to start producing. Each kelp essence requires the player to have ten of their selected kelp and one [[glass|glass]] in their inventory.
All items produced by an extractor can only be base (non-star) quality.
1 extractor is needed to be crafted for the « The extractor ».

The recipe for [[crafting|crafting]] a furnace will be received from [[pablo|Pablo]] after the player obtains [[bronze-ore|bronze ore]] in the [[cavern|Cavern]] for the first time. The next morning after the player leaves their [[farmhouse|farmhouse]], Pablo will visit and give them the recipe.
1 furnace is needed to be crafted for the « All ore nothing ».

To [[crafting|craft]] the Slime of Replication, the player must reach level 10 in their [[combat|Combat]] mastery or read the Book 'How to Craft: Rare Items Edition' from the Library unlocked at Town Rank D.
